notes: mimmûl is fused under rule 30 and headed on mûl, which carries the spatial content min lacks (rule 23, first clause); the competing reading heading the pair on min and on over, as rule 23 does for mēʿal, is named in that unit's note. The chapter reads lənegdî (22.32) and liqrāʾt (22.34) the same way, so the reading is consistent rather than local.
There is a people come out is a presentative recasting of the finite verb under rule 17, leaving the subject noun its own a people.
The directive he of pəṯôrāh takes the written to under rule 32.
